A task failed; must re-plan before continuing.
Every task is marked DONE, but the human has not yet verified the per-task evidence. COMPLETED is not reachable without them (1.9.0).
All tasks DONE and the human confirmed the completion report.

new plan id
blocking wait

rework (1.13.0): only the named tasks reopen; every other task keeps DONE and its result_log; no re-approval, the task list did not change
whole-plan redraft for add/delete/reorder; sets rework_from_completion so the redraft carries evidence for surviving titles
1.13.0: never unlock a plan with nothing left to run - that would skip the completion gate

same plan id, revision

transition.call: plan_and_think(final, task_updates incl. the failed task)
transition.note: 3.0.0 local repair: the failed task gets the new wording, failure_note and PENDING; later unfinished tasks may be rewritten too; DONE tasks are untouched and keep result_log; the human re-approves
whole re-plan, as in 2.0: finished work is not carried; noted and audited repair_ignored
3.0.0: each named task's done_when becomes what the human wrote (done_when_by=user), in the same transaction; a task not on screen or already DONE records nothing
1.16.0: the draft is submitted (straight to the page when there is one)
1.16.0: circuit breaker, reason thinking_budget
1.16.0: redirected; only the human's REVISE reopens a plan
1.16.0 (D26): redirected to the completion report; used to reach DRAFTING and delete every result_log

transition.from: any, request open on the page
transition.note: 1.16.0: held like the approval call; returns the decision, or a refusal if undecided; the thought is attached as an agent note
1.16.0: ANSWER_USER with the finished results
1.16.0: overlay, not a status; every tool refuses with LOOP_HALTED; halt card on the page
the draft becomes the task list, with the draft's alternatives and the human's picks applied (2.0.0)

2.0.0: each task with options gets chosen; the picked option becomes its title; a pick not on screen records nothing. 3.0.0 (D27): a choice already decided on an earlier approval is kept when no pick arrives, and a DONE task is never re-decided
guidance leads every hint until the next milestone; DRAFTING gets a fresh thinking budget

transition.from: any unfinished, least recently used, idle >= evict_min_idle
transition.call: (another conversation starts a plan while max_active_plans are active)
transition.note: 3.0.0 LRU eviction, PLANNING_MCP_EVICT_LRU: the plan is removed, its id remembered in state.evicted, its tasks and evidence written to the audit log (plan_evicted), its request withdrawn from the page. Every active plan in use -> the new plan is refused (PLAN_AMBIGUOUS), as before 3.0
never fails; reports halted / draft_tasks / thinking_steps_left

3.1.0 PLANNING_MCP_AUTO_ASK: the server opens the plan request in this call and waits; the response is the human's decision, or APPROVAL_PENDING saying the plan was recorded. Not under autoapprove; suppressed when a loop trip was decided in the same call
3.1.0: the server opens the completion report in this call and waits; COMPLETED / rework / APPROVAL_PENDING is the answer to the DONE

transition.from: APPROVED/IN_EXECUTION, stop asked on the run card
transition.note: 3.1.0: the DONE is recorded, the next task is NOT started; every tool refuses with PLAN_PAUSED; pause card (HALT, origin user) on the page
3.1.0: the held task is started (auto-advance); what the human typed - or their memo from the stop - leads the next hint

transition.from: APPROVED/IN_EXECUTION, note asked on the run card
transition.note: 3.1.0: the DONE is recorded; pending_revision {targets: first unfinished task, origin: run, open: the other unfinished tasks}; rework_from_completion set so finished work survives a whole task_list too
3.1.0: each rewritten task carries the note (revision_note) and its previous wording; DONE tasks untouched; audited tasks_steered
3.1.0 (D30): a plan that is no longer waiting is not asked about again - the answer is the confirmation, or what the human asked to change

content check: bare success phrases and task-title echoes rejected regardless of length; floor PLANNING_MCP_MIN_RESULT_LOG=8 normalized chars

guard.call: update_task_progress(DONE, files names a file that is missing or empty)
